'''Ebruchi fighters''' were [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] used by the [[Ebruchi]] Pirates in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. A complement of these fighters were used by [[Creysis]] [[Skirmish between the Admonitor and Creysis's scout squadron|against]] the ''[[Admonitor]]'', during which most of them were destroyed.
